results.title: Trump denounces 'crooked' US midterms after Republican debacle
results.content: US President Donald Trump on Thursday denounced "crooked" elections after the Democrats' victory in this week's midterms.

results.title: Japan: Commuters flock to see two goats grazing at Tokyo station
results.content: Two white goats have become unlikely celebrities in central Tokyo after being recruited to clear overgrown vegetation near Yotsuya railway station. Their eco-friendly gardening duties are attracting crowds of delighted onlookers.

results.title: Arab parties back Eisenkot as Israel faces coalition deadlock
results.content: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he will announce on Sunday whom he will task with trying to form a new government, after the opposition's Gadi Eisenkot secured a commanding number of recommendations to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

results.title: Russia, Ukraine escalate mutual strikes in Black Sea ahead of Abu Dhabi talks
results.content: Russia’s defense ministry on Thursday claimed its forces struck a cargo ship carrying military supplies in the Black Sea just south of Odesa. This follows months of continuous attacks by Ukraine on vessels entering and leaving Russian ports in the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov.

results.title: Tanzania opposition leader Tundu Lissu awaits verdict in treason trial
results.content: After 19 months in detention, Tanzania's main opposition leader Tundu Lissu will know his fate on Friday in a treason trial that has drawn international criticism and carries a potential death penalty.

results.title: Transition to renewable energy key issue at COP 31 talks
results.content: UN climate negotiations beginning in Turkey next week will follow marked by a environmental disasters including heatwaves across Europe and catastrophic flooding in Nepal. A key issue at this year’s talks is the implementation of pledges to phase out fossil fuels.

results.title: Kenyan cult leader faces death sentence over child murders
results.content: Last month, he was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult between January 2021 and September 2023, alongside 28 co-accused. His lawyer said he would appeal.

results.title: Paraguay: Thousands protest banking scandal as president faces impeachment
results.content: Thousands of Paraguayans have taken to the streets over a banking scandal that has left nearly half the population without access to their savings. Protesters are demanding President Santiago Peña face impeachment despite his offer to resign.

results.title: Atiku’s candidacy in doubt after Nigerian court ruling
results.content: A Nigerian court Thursday declared invalid the nomination of Atiku Abubakar as the presidential candidate for the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC), just two months before the country's elections.

results.title: Refugee team competes at Senegal’s first Youth Olympics
results.content: Refugee athletes from camps in Kenya and Uganda are competing at the Youth Olympics in Senegal, marking the first time a refugee team has taken part in the event.

results.title: West Bank: Palestinians harvest olives under Israeli military restrictions
results.content: Palestinian farmers in the occupied West Bank have been allowed limited access to their olive groves under Israeli military restrictions. Many found damaged trees, while soldiers fired tear gas near the harvest.

results.title: Egypt army says hundreds of illegal gold miners arrested
results.content: At least 72 gold miners were killed, last October, by airstrikes on a gold mine on the Sudan-Egypt border. A rights organisation accused the Egyptian air force of carrying out the attack

results.title: Spain: Zelensky urges Latin America to help repair Ukraine's power grid
results.content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has appealed to Spain and Latin American countries for urgent help repairing Ukraine's damaged energy infrastructure. He also met King Felipe VI during the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid.

results.title: 'Fighting won't stop': Ethiopia clashes drive thousands into Kenya
results.content: Deadly clashes between armed forces in southern Ethiopia have driven tens of thousands into neighbouring Kenya with no idea when they can safely return home

results.title: Moonshot 2026: Experts call for urgent reforms to unlock intra-African trade {Business Africa}
results.content: Experts at Moonshot 2026 in Lagos call for harmonised regulations and seamless digital payments to boost intra-African trade and as Silicon Valley pulls back, home-grown startups are stepping up to shape the continent's digital future.

results.title: Guinea expels Burkinabé gold miners, draws Ougadougou's fury
results.content: More than 8,000 Burkinabé gold miners were forcibly expelled from Guinea-Conakry after authorities there imposed a ban on artisanal and illegal gold mining in several areas of the country's northeast

results.title: Greece: Students march in Athens demanding more education funding
results.content: Thousands of pupils, students and teachers marched through central Athens on Thursday in a nationwide push for better-funded schools, joining a protest wave that has spread from France across southern Europe.

results.title: Nigerian court nullifies Atiku Abubakar's presidential candidacy
results.content: A Nigerian court on Thursday declared invalid the nomination of Atiku Abubakar as the presidential candidate for the opposition African Democratic Congress, with just two months to go before the country's elections.

results.title: Commonwealth leaders welcome UK dialogue on harms of transatlantic slave trade
results.content: Commonwealth leaders welcome Britain's agreement to engage in "time-bound inclusive and good-faith dialogue" over the "historical harms" of the transatlantic slave trade, during the closing press briefing of Commonwealth Heads of Government meeting (CHOGM).

results.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces international retirement from Portugal
results.content: Cristiano Ronaldo on Thursday announced his retirement from international football, ending a more than two-decade career with Portugal's national team.

results.title: Experts gather in Namibia for nuclear test verification exercise
results.content: The Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) prohibits all nuclear weapons test explosions. Although it is yet to enter into force, a global norm against nuclear testing is emerging

results.title: Extension of Mohamud's presidential term unlawful, Somalia's Supreme Court rules
results.content: Somalia's Supreme Court ruled on Thursday that the extension of the president's term by one year, which sparked violent clashes with the opposition, was “unlawful".

results.title: A theatre festival in Morocco's capital celebrates six women directors
results.content: Six women theatre directors showcased their art and vision in the Jassad international festival in Rabat from October 27 to 30.

results.title: France: Up to 55,000 march in Lyon amid clashes and tear gas
results.content: Tens of thousands marched through Lyon area during a nationwide strike over wages and purchasing power. Police charged demonstrators and used tear gas as clashes erupted along the protest route.

results.title: James Barnor, who captured Ghana’s independence, wins top photography honour at 97
results.content: James Barnor, who photographed Ghana’s independence and Black life in 1960s London, will receive a top honour at the 2027 Sony World Photography Awards.

results.title: Egypt-US sign $625 framework agreement aimed at advancing mutual prosperity
results.content: Egypt and the United States signed a framework agreement on Wednesday aimed at advancing mutual prosperity. The US contributions could reach up to $625 million over five years.

results.title: Verdict expected in Tanzanian opposition leader's treason case
results.content: Tundu Lissu faces a treason charge carrying a possible death sentence as the High Court in Dar es Salaam is set to deliver its verdict on November 6

results.title: Political consultations ongoing in Israel to form new government
results.content: Consultations between Israeli President Isaac Herzog and political parties to form a new government in Israel are set to conclude on Thursday, more than a week after divisive general elections.

results.title: France: Mass protests and school blockades mark fourth national strike
results.content: Hundreds of thousands joined a fourth nationwide day of protests across France. Police used tear gas outside a Paris school, while major demonstrations disrupted Marseille and Nantes.
